channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Israeli attack on car in central Gaza kills three Palestinians
item.description: Palestinian Interior Ministry says those killed in attack on Maghazi refugee camp were police officers.

item.title: Trump blames Iran for ‘foolish’ strike on cargo ship in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Fragile US-Iran ceasefire tested as drone strike off Oman draws stern warning from the US president.

item.title: Why did these World Cup ads strike a nerve in Egypt?
item.description: A viral World Cup campaign tapped into a familiar conversation among Egyptian football fans, prompting debate.

item.title: Nine people killed in building collapse in Lagos, Nigeria
item.description: Twenty seven people were rescued with injuries of varying severity; governor orders safety checks on surrounding area.

item.title: Hezbollah: Israel must ‘unconditionally’ leave Lebanon
item.description: Hezbollah says Israel has "no option" but to “unconditionally” withdraw from southern Lebanon and other occupied areas.

item.title: Why has the UN paused plans to evacuate sailors from the Strait of Hormuz?
item.description: A cargo vessel had been struck by a projectile near Oman, as Iran says all ships must pass with its permission.

item.title: Mother dies saving daughter in Venezuela earthquakes
item.description: Héctor Bello wrote on social media that "you gave your own life for our daughter" in the quakes which killed at least 920 people.

item.title: Trump accuses Iran of ceasefire breach after Strait of Hormuz attack
item.description: A Singapore-flagged ship was struck crossing the waterway on Thursday, prompting a large-scale evacuation to be paused.

item.title: Israel and Lebanon sign framework agreement after US-brokered talks
item.description: Previous ceasefires between Israel and Hezbollah have still seen near-daily cross-border strikes

item.title: Christmas market attacker jailed for life for murdering six in Germany
item.description: A nine-year-old and five women were killed when Taleb Al-Abdulmohsen drove into the market in 2024.
